g.text: sorted_token_ids: the pair ids in expert order, each expert padded to a multiple of BLOCK_SIZE_M (4 here)
expert_ids = [e0, e2, e3]: one expert for each block. A pad holds an id >= M x top_k, so the kernel masks it.
4. write the results to rows p1 and p2 of cache1
The program reads in token order and writes in pair order. No program copies x.
